Method of Attack: Device impersonation vulnerability allowing remote attacker to gain access to live audio and video streams or take control of the vulnerable device
Exploitation of device unique identifier (UID) to register attacker-controlled device on Kalay network and intercept client connection attempts
Exploitation of vulnerabilities in device-implemented RPC interface leading to complete device compromise
Impacted Systems: Devices using ThroughTek’s Kalay IoT cloud platform
Home automation IoT systems using Kalay network
Attack Vector: Registration on Kalay network using device UID obtained via vendor web API
Exploitation of Kalay protocol SDK in mobile and desktop applications
